evidence.quote: Add a new EIP-2718 transaction type that allows Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs) to set the code in their account.
This EIP does not provide developers the opportunity to run initcode and set storage slots during delegation.
clients do not accept more than one pending transaction for any EOA with a non-zero delegation indicator

notes.zh:
交集：AI Agent 需要一个可编程账户来收付款、限额、批量调用和恢复权限；EIP-7702 让 EOA 在单笔交易里委托一段代码，给「代理执行」提供了账户层入口。
适用范围：官方规范只定义「EOA 设置代码」的交易格式、授权元组与委托指示符；它不替开发者初始化存储，也不保证钱包界面能正确展示委托状态。客户端被建议对已有委托的 EOA 只接受一笔待处理交易，以降低交易失效风险。
未解决：委托代码的升级与撤销、会话密钥的生命周期、被委托合约的安全审计，以及不同钱包对 7702 的展示与风控口径，都还在演进。
notes.en:
Intersection: AI agents need a programmable account for payments, spending limits, batching and permission recovery; EIP-7702 lets an EOA delegate to code within a transaction, giving agent execution an account-level entry point.
Scope: the official spec only defines the transaction format, authorization tuples and delegation indicator for an EOA setting code; it does not initialise storage for developers or guarantee that wallets display delegation correctly. Clients are advised to accept only one pending transaction for an EOA with a non-zero delegation indicator to reduce invalidation risk.
Open: delegation upgrades and revocation, session-key lifecycles, security audits of delegated contracts, and wallet display/risk policy for 7702 are still evolving.

specs.作用 / effect: EOA 可在交易中委托代码执行
specs.协议状态 / status: 已部署（Final；随 Pectra 升级上线）
specs.许可 / license: CC0（EIP 文本，以官方页为准）
